  <section id="path" class="lp-reveal">
    <div class="lp-label">Why this wiki</div>
    <h2>Learning fails when the path is invisible</h2>
    <p class="lp-lead">Class notes get lost. Sprint goals stay only in the teacher's head. Students don't see the full journey, and the link between "today" and "the whole course" breaks.</p>
    <div class="lp-split">
      <div class="lp-split-card teacher">
        <h3>What the teacher needs</h3>
        <ul class="lp-list">
          <li>A living Sprint Backlog that is easy to update every day</li>
          <li>A Product Backlog that keeps the full history</li>
          <li>Clear marks: <code>++</code> new topic, <code>----</code> pending to future</li>
          <li>One place that links commits, masterDocs, diagrams and labs</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="lp-split-card student">
        <h3>What the student needs</h3>
        <ul class="lp-list">
          <li>Know exactly what we did today and what comes next</li>
          <li>See the whole roadmap, not only the current day</li>
          <li>Find reference articles and previous labs quickly</li>
          <li>Feel progress instead of guessing</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- The solution -->
  <section class="lp-reveal">
    <div class="lp-label">The connection</div>
    <h2>One shared path. Visible to both.</h2>
    <p class="lp-lead">Every course edition follows the same pattern: Official docs · Sprint Backlog · Product Backlog · Calendar &amp; Deliveries. The Sprint is the live plan for the week; when the week ends it is pasted into the Product Backlog and a new Sprint starts.</p>
    <div class="lp-grid">
      <a class="lp-card" href="ifcd0021-26/ifcd0021-backlog-sprint-26.html"><div class="lp-card-icon">🗂</div><h3>Sprint Backlog</h3>
        <p class="lp-muted">The plan for this week, day by day, with numbered steps. <code>++</code> for new topics, <code>----</code> for what moves to the future.</p></a>
      <a class="lp-card" href="ifcd0021-26/ifcd0021-backlog-product-26.html"><div class="lp-card-icon">🗃</div><h3>Product Backlog</h3>
        <p class="lp-muted">The permanent history. Every finished week is pasted here, month by month, so the full journey stays visible.</p></a>
      <a class="lp-card" href="ifcd0021-26/ifcd0021-deliveries-26.html"><div class="lp-card-icon">📅</div><h3>Calendar &amp; Deliveries</h3>
        <p class="lp-muted">Official dates, evaluation weights (30% continuous, 70% final) and how to deliver the exercises.</p></a>
      <a class="lp-card" href="ifcd0021-26/ifcd0021-26.html"><div class="lp-card-icon">📜</div><h3>Official Docs</h3>
        <p class="lp-muted">The Certificat de Professionalitat: modules, hours and the general competence of the course.</p></a>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Methodology -->
  <section id="method" class="lp-reveal">
    <div class="lp-label">The weekly rhythm</div>
    <h2>How we keep the path alive</h2>
    <div class="lp-steps">
      <div class="lp-step"><div class="lp-step-num">1</div><div><h3>Plan the Sprint</h3><p class="lp-muted">Monday: write the sprint header and the daily topics with numbered steps.</p></div></div>
      <div class="lp-step"><div class="lp-step-num">2</div><div><h3>Update every day</h3><p class="lp-muted">Mark progress, add <code>++</code> for new topics, strike what we skip, link the commit and the masterDoc.</p></div></div>
      <div class="lp-step"><div class="lp-step-num">3</div><div><h3>Close the week</h3><p class="lp-muted">Paste the finished week into the Product Backlog. Start a fresh Sprint.</p></div></div>
      <div class="lp-step"><div class="lp-step-num">4</div><div><h3>Students always see the truth</h3><p class="lp-muted">The pages the teacher updates are the pages students open. No hidden plan. <a href="scrum/scrum-what-concepts.html" style="color:var(--accent-light)">Why SCRUM →</a></p></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="lp-marks">
      <div class="lp-mark"><b>-</b>topic planned or done</div>
      <div class="lp-mark"><b>----</b>topic pending to future</div>
      <div class="lp-mark"><b>++</b>new topic not planned</div>
    </div>
  </section>
